verdict.rationale: Teller publishes a headline coverage number, "more than 7,000 financial institutions", with same-day ACH microdeposit verification as a fallback for unsupported banks. The pack shows no documented geography, country list, or searchable institution directory a founder could check against their own users' banks. The only geographic detail is a dated community thread naming a handful of UK banks, plus a user complaining that coverage was UK-only; neither describes current coverage. Missing for 10: explicit statement of supported countries/regions, a published per-institution coverage list or lookup, and independent corroboration of the 7,000 figure.
